sanity_expectations: Pr starts at 0 and rises as coherent tunneling transfers population to the right well
Pr exhibits damped coherent oscillations (Rabi-like) with period near 2*pi/Omega ~ 6 time units
Pr stays bounded within [0,1] as a probability
N decays monotonically from 1 toward N_eq=0.6 (coherence loss)
oscillation amplitude of Pr decreases over time as N shrinks and dephasing acts
Pr settles toward a quasi-steady imbalance consistent with m_eq=0 (Pr ~ 0.5) modulated by residual coherent drive
excitation_report: Full child-vs-parent system comparison on the Pr trajectory over t in [0,40], sigma=0.01 on dPr_dt. The new mechanism (child term Omega*K*N vs parent Omega*K, i.e. the extra Omega*K*(N-1) coupling of the coherence envelope N into population transfer) reaches a peak effect of 0.163 = 16.3x sigma, strongest at t~10.9, where N has relaxed away from its initial value 1 toward N_eq=0.6. Comfortably above the 5x sigma threshold; new term clearly visible.

rationale: Typed ODE-system contract inherited verbatim: 4 states (Pr,J,K,N), target Pr, benchmark output dPr_dt. analyze_expression confirmed the target RHS has no derivatives/integrals and depends only on {Omega,K,N,Pr,gamma_pop,m_eq}, matching labels. Chose t in [0,40] (n=400) to span several coherent tunneling oscillations (period ~6) plus the slower relaxation of the coherence envelope N (gamma_N=0.15). Parameters set to physically sensible magnitudes: Omega=1 sets the frequency scale; small decoherence/relaxation rates (gamma,gamma_pop,gamma_N,gamma_nl ~ 0.05-0.15) keep oscillations underdamped; Omega_sat=1.5 keeps the saturation denominator well-behaved for imbalance in [-1,1]; N_eq=0.6 (below the initial N=1) ensures the envelope moves enough to make the new Omega*K*N coupling visible. excitation_check (is_ode) gives the new term 16.3x sigma at sigma=0.01, so it is clearly excited above the noise.

scenario_text: A quantum particle is placed in a double-well configuration where it can tunnel between two nearly degenerate localized states. The probability of finding the particle in the initially unoccupied well oscillates coherently in time. The measurement follows the slow back-and-forth transfer set by the tunneling coupling. This captures coherent tunneling oscillation between two wells.
